resolved_today.name: Roasted Red Peppers [A12] (= Sapore- Roasted Red Peppers Strips A12)
resolved_today.was: 1 'ea' at $14.00 with needs_pack_review FALSE, so the tin could only be booked whole and no recipe could cost pepper strips by mass. The bridged Lightspeed copy was not even flagged for the chef, while its Gulli twin was.
resolved_today.fix: Pinned to 2500 g in pack_overrides.yaml, giving $0.005600/g. Both spellings of the tin now agree on that rate, which also closes the duplicate-identity gap.
resolved_today.source: NOT guessed and not in our data — the Gulli invoice states no UOM. Taken from the manufacturer's spec sheet published on the supplier's own catalogue: shop.gullifood.com.au product sappepstripa12-uc3 -> Documents -> 'Specifications for Red Roasted Peppers Whole & Strips.pdf', page 2 ('ROASTED PEPPERS RED strips'): Packing Type 'A 12 (5/1) TIN BOX', NET WEIGHT 4200 G, DRAINED WEIGHT 2500 G. The PDF is an image scan and had to be rendered to be read.
resolved_today.judgement: DRAINED (2500 g) chosen over NET (4200 g): a recipe uses the peppers, not the brine, and it is the conservative direction — net would read 1.68x cheap, and CLAUDE.md is explicit that errors flattering GP are the dangerous ones.

resolved_today.name: San Pellegrino 500ml
resolved_today.was: pack_unit 'can', pack_qty 1, so the 500 mL was lost and the item was costed per container while the picker's other sparkling water is costed per ml. 'can' was also factually wrong. The $2.3200 was a Back Office seed dated 2026-01-01.
resolved_today.fix: Pinned to 500 ml. The rate is now $0.004640/ml (x500 = $2.32). build_costs applies the override upstream, so the row reads as a per-ml rate rather than a 500 ml pack — both shapes are correct and the test asserts the rate, not the shape.
resolved_today.source: CONFIRMED from our own invoices, not the label: ILG code 450-1293 'S.PELLEGRINO SPARKLING WATER', raw_uom '24x500ML', on invoices 03690691 (2026-05-05), 03701256 (05-21), 03714643 (06-16), 03729959 (07-14).
resolved_today.note: The stale January seed is already resolving itself as predicted — live ILG invoices have superseded it on the Stowaway id at $0.004712/ml as of 2026-08-04.

clean_notes.name: Chicken Whole Bird [No.8]
clean_notes.why_clean: Name complete, cost confirmed at $6.10 across ~10 B&E invoices, and 'ea' matches the supplier's own raw_uom 'PCS' — B&E genuinely sells it by the piece, so per-each is the invoiced basis rather than a parser artefact.

pipeline_fix: Separately from the two products above: pack_overrides.yaml previously had NO EFFECT on any lightspeed:* cost-book row, so every wrong-unit flag this review has raised against one (about thirty spirits on 2026-08-15, both of today's) was unfixable by the mechanism built for it. build_ingredients now applies confirmed packs to cost-book rows, guarded so a COUNT override is never applied to a row that is already per-piece — the first draft of that fix understated nine products by 40x to 288x and was caught by the before/after feed diff. See parser_regression.py TRIAGE LOG items 26-28.
